data.title: Staff Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
data.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

Your Day-to-Day

Own the Execution Plan:

  • Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

  • Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

  • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

  • Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

  • Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

  • Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

    • Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

  • Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

    Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

  • Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams — balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

  • Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

  • Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

data.title: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)
data.description:
Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start ab sofort · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office

Starte deine Sales-Karriere bei Pennylane in Berlin. Als Junior Sales Manager (intern: Sales Development Representative) arbeitest du 100 % Inbound: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

data.description:
Pennylane ist ein französisches Fintech, das 2020 gegründet wurde und seinen Hauptsitz in Paris hat. Wir entwickeln ein Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU und ihre Steuerkanzleien, bei dem KI von Anfang an mitgedacht ist. Unsere Plattform vereint Buchhaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Ausgabenmanagement und Business Banking. Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien arbeiten damit auf einer gemeinsamen Datenbasis – in Echtzeit.

  • 1.200 Mitarbeiter und ein Team, das schnell wächst.

  • Über 1,5 Millionen Unternehmen und 6.000 Steuerkanzleien auf der Plattform.

  • 200 Mio. Euro jährlich wiederkehrender Umsatz (ARR) im Jahr 2025 – rund doppelt so viel wie im Vorjahr.

  • 175 Mio. Euro Finanzierung im Januar 2026 bei einer Bewertung von 3,5 Mrd. Euro. Zu unseren Investoren zählen TCV, Blackstone, Sequoia, DST Global, CapitalG und Meritech.

  • Expansion in Europa: Seit Ende 2025 sind wir in Deutschland aktiv. Die Einführung der E-Rechnung gibt der Digitalisierung des Finanzwesens zusätzlichen Rückenwind.

Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit.

Warum wir dich suchen

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Als Paid Marketing Manager Germany übernimmst du unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise von der Strategie bis zur Optimierung. Du machst aus Werbebudget qualifizierte Leads und behältst dabei die Kundenakquisekosten im Blick.

Deine Mission

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen.

Dein Team und Umfeld

Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad. Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager.

Für den deutschen Markt liegt Paid Acquisition vollständig in deiner Hand: Strategie, Budget, Umsetzung und Performance. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren internationalen und lokalen Teams zusammen:

  • Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

  • Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen.

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

  • Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

  • Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

  • Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du kannst den deutschen Markt eigenständig steuern und arbeitest erfolgreich mit einem verteilten, überwiegend in Frankreich ansässigen Team zusammen.


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up oder einem anderen stark wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen B2B-, Fintech- oder Buchhaltungsmarkts.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Tracking, etwa Tags, Data Layer und Conversions API, um dich mit Growth Engineering auf Augenhöhe auszutauschen.

  • Französischkenntnisse.

data.description:
Über uns

ZEP ist eine cloudbasierte Software für Projektcontrolling – von der Projektzeiterfassung über Abwesenheitsverwaltung bis zur Abrechnung. Mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen, vor allem projektorientierte Dienstleister wie Beratungen, IT- und Engineering-Unternehmen, arbeiten bereits mit ZEP.

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2000 sind wir inhabergeführt und kontinuierlich gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und noch mehr Unternehmen von ZEP überzeugen. Als Marketing Lead entwickelst du die passenden Ideen und Maßnahmen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und unser Wachstum aktiv voranzutreiben.

Du willst Marketing nicht nur umsetzen, sondern verantworten – mit klaren Pipeline-Zielen, eigenem Budget und einem Team, das du weiterentwickelst?

Als Marketing Lead bei ZEP übernimmst du die Ergebnisverantwortung für unser Marketing und die daraus entstehende Pipeline. Du führst das Marketingteam sowie unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, steuerst das Marketingbudget und greifst aktiv ein, wenn Zahlen vom Plan abweichen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität dort, wo es darauf ankommt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unsere Pipeline-Ziele und das Marketingbudget und steuerst aktiv gegen, wenn Zahlen abweichen.

  • Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung, schärfst Positionierung und Messaging für unsere B2B-Zielgruppen und leitest daraus Ziele und Prioritäten ab.

  • Als Teil des Management-Teams bringst du die Marketingperspektive in strategische Entscheidungen auf Unternehmensebene ein und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von ZEP aktiv mit.

  • Du führst das Marketingteam, setzt Prioritäten und entwickelst die Teammitglieder fachlich und persönlich weiter.

  • Du steuerst und forderst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister – insbesondere im Paid-Bereich (z. B. Google Ads, Paid Social) – mit klaren Zielen und Briefings und misst sie an ihren Ergebnissen.

  • Du baust Demand Generation über mehrere Kanäle auf, nicht nur über Paid.

  • Du verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb die Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Sales.

  • Du sorgst für sauberes Tracking und Attribution über den gesamten Funnel.

  • Du wertest Kampagnen, Funnel und Conversion Rates aus – wenn nötig selbst in HubSpot und im Tracking – und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

  • Du entwickelst SEO und die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchen (AI Search) als wachsenden Kanal weiter.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Website weiter und holst mehr Leads aus dem vorhandenen Traffic.

Deine Voraussetzungen

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit, mit Schwerpunkt Demand Generation.

  • Du hast nachweislich Pipeline- oder Umsatzziele erreicht und hattest Budgetverantwortung.

  • Du hast bereits Führungserfahrung gesammelt: Du hast ein Marketingteam geführt, Prioritäten gesetzt und Mitarbeitende weiterentwickelt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Agenturen und Dienstleister zu steuern und fachlich zu fordern.

  • Du kennst dich mit Performance Marketing (Google Ads, Paid Social) so gut aus, dass du Agenturen auf Augenhöhe führst.

  • Du bist sicher in Analyse, Tracking und Attribution; idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit HubSpot.

  • Du setzt KI selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit ein und weißt, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt.

  • Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher verständigen.

Deine Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und unbefristete Arbeitsverträge

  • Remote First Company – Arbeite innerhalb Deutschlands von wo du möchtest!

  • Unterstützung bei der Home-Office Einrichtung

  • Chancen, Freiheiten und Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten eines Startups verbunden mit der Sicherheit eines seit über 20 Jahren etablierten Unternehmens im Mittelstand.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Keine Kernarbeitszeiten, stimme dich einfach mit dem Team ab.

  • Windows oder Mac? Entscheide selbst!

  • 50 EUR monatlicher Gutschein für verschiedene Sachbezüge oder Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

  • Jobrad mit Arbeitgeber-Zuschuss

  • offene team- und ergebnisorientierte Kultur

  • regelmäßige Workshops, Mittagessen und Events zum Teambuilding

  • Individuelle Altersvorsorgepläne

Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest und diesen Bereich aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

data.title: Senior SAP FICO Consultant (m/f/d)
data.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. 

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. 

As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. 

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective 

About the Role

  • Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. 
  • Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. 
  • Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. 
  • Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. 
  • Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. 
  • Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. 
  • Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4HANA), with a strong focus on Finance (FI/CO) and Procurement (MM).
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Additional working knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and Asset Management modules. 
  • At least two full end-to-end SAP implementations, ideally in a company of similar size and complexity to Flix. 
  • Solid understanding of core finance and procurement processes: General Ledger, Accounts Payable / Receivable, Fixed Assets, Controlling, Purchase-to-Pay. 
  • Experience working with external system integrators and the confidence to engage with them as an equal partner. 
  • Comfortable engaging with senior Finance and Procurement stakeholders and translating between business and SAP language. 
  • Structured, pragmatic, delivery-oriented; strong communication and facilitation skills. 
  • Based in Germany, you're fluent in German and English. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

data.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

data.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (App Installs)
data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll manage paid media channels to drive profitable acquisition of new app users, aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Scaling and optimizing app acquisition campaigns in Google, Microsoft and Apple ad platforms

  • Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift

  • Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging to improve app install conversion

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable user growth. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, app acquisition, subscriber growth, paid advertising, and creative testing. Responsibilities may also include owning a portfolio of existing channels (Google ads, paid social, app install campaigns) with the goal of efficiently scaling profitable advertising. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles with 2+ years of experience in marketing consumer apps preferred.

  • Hands-on expertise standing up and managing paid digital advertising programs (Google Ads, Apple Ads, etc.) as well as familiarity with non-digital paid media management (CTV, TV, etc.).

  • Demonstrated track record of profitably scaling app install growth programs while improving efficiency and unit economics as volume materially scales.

  • Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

  • Experience designing and running incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies, PSA/ghost ads) to validate true channel impact and guide investment decisions.

  • Advanced analytical abilities, including modeling app economics (payback, LTV), data analysis, scenario planning, and projecting campaign outcomes across spend and volume curves.

  • Track record of running creative testing as an always on pipeline, consistently shipping new concepts to prevent performance decay and unlock incremental scale.

  • Passion for ideating and problem solving to deliver creative solutions for profitable user growth.

  • Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Compensation

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation, plus stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD

  • United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP

  • Canada: CA$253,500 CAD

  • All other regions*: €157,350 EUR

*Team members outside the US, UK and Canada are currently paid $178,500 USD. Pay converts to the EUR amount above on January 1, 2027 for Spanish team members, and approximately February 1, 2027 in all other regions.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

data.title: Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Justice.

DEINE MISSION

Als Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Container-Infrastruktur reibungslos läuft und zukunftsfähig bleibt. Deine Mission ist es, eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare und sichere Plattform zu schaffen, auf der unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team treibst du die Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Cloud-Umgebung voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung, Konzeption und Implementierung von Private Cloud Plattformen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren Fachteams zur Bereitstellung der nötigen Infrastruktur

  • Messung, Analyse und Optimierung der Performance und Stabilität

  • Aufbau und Betrieb verteilter Systeme unter Anwendung des DevOps-Ansatzes

  • Förderung von Continuous Integration & Deployment-Prozessen für eine effiziente und schnelle Bereitstellung der Lösungen

  • Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cloud-/Plattformbetrieb

  • Erfahrung in der agilen Entwicklung und im Betrieb von verteilten Systemen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Ansible sind unerlässlich

  • Erfahrung in der Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung in Konfiguration und Betrieb sowie in der Entstörung von Proxies

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für DevOps-Praktiken ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrungen mit CI/CD-Pipelines OpenShift und mit JavaEE sind ein Plus

data.title: Senior Solutions Architect / Sales Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Solutions Architect to own end-to-end solution design and technical leadership for TYTAN's C-UAS systems. This is a senior architecture role: you will design how our systems integrate into customer IT, C2, and service-management environments, and you will be the technical authority other architects and engineers look to on complex, multi-stakeholder programs. 

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for TYTAN's C-UAS systems and their integration into customer IT and C2 environments. 

  • Apply NAF v4 and/or ADMBw architecture frameworks to structure customer-facing and internal solution designs. 

  • Design and govern the full IT-service lifecycle, from requirements through deployment, operations, and decommissioning. 

  • Architect solutions spanning cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

  • Lead and mentor internal and external architects and technical teams across complex programs. 

  • Apply TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL practices to structure architecture governance and IT service management processes. 

  • Represent TYTAN's technical architecture to customers, partners, and integrators. 


  • Defense-sector experience is mandatory; a former military background is strongly preferred. 

  • Practical, hands-on experience with Sparx Enterprise Architect, NAF v4 and/or ADMBw. 

  • Strong IT, software, or systems architecture background. 

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in solution architecture or technical IT consulting. 

  • Experience with TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL; relevant certifications preferred. 

  • Experience designing complex IT service-management platforms and processes. 

  • Experience with cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead internal and external architects and technical teams. 

  • Fluent German and English. 

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

data.title: Masterarbeit/Werkstudent – Agentic AI & Multi-Agenten-Systeme (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Künstliche Intelligenz verändert zunehmend die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen arbeiten und Geschäftsprozesse gestalten. Wir möchten diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten und bauen dafür ein agentisches KI-System auf, das unterschiedliche Geschäftsbereiche unterstützt und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Teams effizienter gestaltet.

Zur Unterstützung dieses innovativen Vorhabens suchen wir einen engagierten Masterstudent für eine Abschlussarbeit oder einen Werkstudent (m/w/d) mit Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz, Softwareentwicklung und Multi-Agenten-Systemen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Multi-Agenten-Architektur: Konzeption, wie Agenten Arbeit aufteilen, Aufgaben übergeben und Kontext teilen.

  • Agenten-Konfiguration: Definition der Agenten über strukturierte Markdown-Dateien und Bewertung, wie spezialisiert („fine-tuned“) ein Agent sein sollte.

  • Erweiterungen und Integrationen: Entwicklung von Erweiterungen und Anbindung interner und externer Systeme perAPI-Key.

  • Agentic Coding: Aufbau agentischer Coding-Funktionen – ein oder mehrere zusammenarbeitende KI-Agenten, die direkt in unserer Entwicklungsumgebung Code planen, schreiben, testen und reviewen.

  • Richtlinien: Erstellung von Security-, Extension-Security- und Coding-Guidelines für Entwicklung und Betrieb der Agenten.

  • Token-Optimierung: Messung und Reduktion von Tokenverbrauch und Kosten durch Kontextmanagement, Caching und Modellwahl.

  • Change Management: Konzept für Wissenstransfer, Rollout und Akzeptanz, damit die Agenten in Prozesse und Teams integriert werden

  • Dokumentation: Aufbereitung und Präsentation der Ergebnisse für Stakeholder.


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Masterstudium (für die Abschlussarbeit) oder Immatrikulation als Werkstudent:in in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach

  • Nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung aus Projekten, Jobs oder Open Source (z. B. Python oder TypeScript, Git, REST-APIs)

  • Praktische KI-Erfahrung, z. B. mit LLM-APIs, Prompt Engineering oder KI-gestütztem Programmieren

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntniss

  • Erfahrung mit agentischen Workflows oder Frameworks (z. B. MCP, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)

  • Kenntnisse agentischer Coding-Tools (z. B. Cursor, Cline oder Claude Code)

  • Interesse an organisatorischen Themen wie Change Management und Wissenstransfer

  • Grundverständnis von Software-Security

data.title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) AI-Startup
data.description:
Du kannst gut verkaufen? Dann könnten wir gut Matchen.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales auf selbstständiger Basis, zunächst ideal als Nebenjob. Du hast die Chance, früh in ein internationales AI-Startup einzusteigen, ein Vertriebsteam aufzubauen und dies für den gesamten deutschen Markt zu leiten. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt ist auf Wunsch ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag + Fixgehalt vorgesehen.

Über uns

Wir sind ein Startup und arbeiten überwiegend remote. Optional kannst du auch vor Ort aus Hamburg, London oder Prag mit uns arbeiten.

Aktuell bauen wir Fenie auf, eine innovative KI-Assistentin speziell für Kosmetikstudios und Unternehmen aus der Beauty-Branche. Fenie hilft die Beauty Branche dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation zu automatisieren.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sale (m/w/d), der Vertrieb im Blut hat und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Vergütung & Perspektive

Aktuell bieten wir kein fixes Grundgehalt, da wir uns noch in der Growth-Phase befinden. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt daher auf selbstständiger Basis, (siehe unten unter „Vergütung“).

Damit bietet gleichzeitig bewusst einige Vorteile für diejenigen, die an unserem Wachstum partizipieren möchten.

Du kannst ein eigenes Vertriebsteam aufbauen und zusätzlich an dessen Provisionen mitverdienen. Dazu kommen deine eigene Provision sowie wiederkehrende Provisionen, die deutlich höher ausfallen als bei vergleichbaren Jobangeboten.

Bei unserem zweiten Startup verdienen unsere Kollegen, die Head of Sales Mitarbeiter aktuell zwischen 6.000 und 7.000 € im Monat, ein realistischer Einblick dafür, was nach einer kurzen Zeit möglich ist.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Vertrieb

  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundenakquise, insbesondere Telefonakquise und Cold Calling

  • Du hast bereits nachweislich Erfahrung darin, potenzielle Kunden aktiv anzusprechen und für ein Produkt oder eine Dienstleistung zu gewinnen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Einwandbehandlung und Follow-ups

  • Im besten Fall Erfahrungen in der Beauty und Software Bernache

  • Absolut Zuverlässigkeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst Kosmetik, Beauty- und ähnliche Studios telefonisch durch Cold Calling. Eine freundliche und meist lockere Zielgruppe.

  • Leads stellen wir zu Verfügung

  • Du stellst Fenie potenziellen Kunden vor

  • Du erklärst einfach und verständlich, welchen Mehrwert KI im Alltag bietet

  • Du baust auf Wunsch ein Team auf uns leitest dies

  • Du arbeitest neue Vertriebsmitarbeiter ein

Was dich bei Fenie erwartet

  • Ein schnell wachsendes AI-Startup

  • 100 % Remote, innerhalb Europa

  • Die Möglichkeit, das gesamtes Vertriebsteam für den deutschen Markt zu leiten

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung innerhalb unserer Vertriebszeiten zwischen 9 und 17 Uhr

  • Hohes Provisionsmodell durch hohe Margen im Softwaregeschäft

  • Wiederkehrende hohe Provisionen sind Standard

  • Einstieg in einer frühen Startup-Phase

Vergütung

· 50 % Provision auf Erstzahlungen

· 20 % Provision auf monatlich wiederkehrende Zahlungen (unsere AI verkaufen wir ausschließlich im Abo Modelle und mit Jahresplänen)

· 10 % Provision auf Umsätze deines Vertriebsteams, was du führen kannst - deutschlandweit

Interesse?

Schreib uns einfach kurz, wer du bist, welche Vertriebserfahrung du mitbringst und warum du Lust darauf hast, Fenie gemeinsam mit uns aufzubauen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Dein Fenie Team

Du suchst einen Job im Bereich Social Media und möchtest etwas neues lernen?

Starte jetzt im Bereich Social Media und KI-Management durch. Ganz egal, ob in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.

Schritt 1: Die Schulung

Wir bereiten dich auf diesen Beruf vor. Lerne mit uns die erforderlichen Kenntnisse und werde zum Experten für Social Media und Künstliche Intelligenz. Die Schulung kannst du ganz bequem online von zu Hause aus erledigen, mit flexibler Zeiteinteilung und innerhalb weniger Wochen.

Schritt 2: Die Arbeit

Nach der Schulung bist du bereit zu starten. Entscheide selber, welcher Arbeitsbereich dir am besten gefällt und zu dir und deiner persönlichen Situation passt. Sowohl von den Aufgaben als auch der Arbeitszeiten.

Über Digital Evolution AI

Wir sind ein Schulungsanbieter und begleiten dich auf deinem Weg in einen neuen beruflichen Bereich. Du startest bei uns mit einer Weiterbildung und erhältst anschließend Zugang zu verschiedenen Jobangeboten, die zu deiner aktuellen Situation passen. So begleiten wir dich von der Schulung bis zum Berufseinstieg.

Unser Ziel ist es, das notwendige Fachwissen zu vermitteln, um langfristig erfolgreich im Bereich Social Media und KI-Management arbeiten zu können.

Unser Schulungsprogramm richtet sich sowohl an Quereinsteiger, die etwas Neues lernen und ihren Berufsweg verändern möchten, als auch an Personen mit ersten Vorkenntnissen. Die Schulung kann einfach und flexibel online absolviert werden.

Deine Vorteile

  • Ein Beruf mit Zukunft, dank neusten AI Wissen

  • Unterstützung bei der Schulung

  • Kostenübernahme durch die Agentur für Arbeit oder auch privat möglich

  • Flexible Teilnahme im Homeoffice

Das erwartet dich

  • Erstellung von Inhalten für soziale Medien und digitale Werbekampagnen

  • Arbeit mit modernen Marketing- und KI-Tools

  • Entwicklung von Content-Strategien für verschiedene Plattformen

  • Planung, Umsetzung und Analyse von Kampagnen

Dein Profil

  • Interesse an Social Media, Content-Erstellung und digitalem Marketing

  • Kreativität und Freude an digitalen Medien

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Social Media, Büroorganisation oder Kundenservice sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau)

Bewirb dich jetzt

Wenn du dich angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Nach Eingang deiner Unterlagen melden wir uns zeitnah bei dir zurück.

data.title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
data.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines.

  • Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem.

  • Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting.

  • Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent.

Requirements

  • 5+ year track record in high-volume blue-collar manufacturing hiring in innovative manufacturing environments

  • Deep network within European manufacturing and industrial talent pools

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

data.title: Channel Partnerships Manager, DACH
data.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

As Partnerships Manager, you will be joining as a core member of Airwallex’s Commercial team in EMEA and the first partnerships manager on the ground in Germany. You will be responsible for identifying and building partnerships across our core verticals of travel, SaaS and e-Commerce. We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly-driven Partnerships Manager who has 5+ years of experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth environment. We operate in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of 3 days a week working in our office in Berlin.

What You'll Be Doing...

  • You will lead, own, and develop a partnership strategy that aligns with our overall GTM in Germany

  • You will be accountable for identifying growth opportunities, testing new verticals, and building a high-quality portfolio of partners

  • You will design a scalable programme to consistently deliver growth in the partnerships channel

  • You will work closely with Marketing, Sales and Strategy teams to position Airwallex’s value proposition to partners and their clients in Germany

  • You will represent Airwallex at industry events and conferences, as well as speak on relevant panels and webinars

What You Bring...

  • Demonstrable interest in fintech, SaaS, and/or payments

  • Strong commercial instincts and a history of meeting or exceeding OKRs/KPIs consistently

  • 5+ years of work experience in partnerships, strategy, business development, or a similar role in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets (G-Suite, Looker) and building and delivering presentations for partners and clients

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in German and English.

Who You Are...

  • Results-driven - you hold yourself accountable for delivering on your targets

  • Proactive - you identify, plan, and execute against opportunities to grow, and you enjoy problem-solving to achieve those goals

  • Laser-focused - you are ruthless in spending time on the highest-impact initiatives in a fast-paced environment

  • Commercially-minded - you enjoy negotiating and you strive to achieve the best outcomes for the business

  • Relationship-oriented - you can build deep and trusting relationships with partners

  • Excellent communicator - you have excellent written and presentation skills

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

data.title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - Germany)
data.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

data.title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
data.description:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We are part of the WERK1 incubation program, which gives us access to apartments in the Werksviertel that never hit the open market. With enough lead time we reserve one for you before you arrive, minutes on foot from the office.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day
