data.title: Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality (all genders)
data.description:
JustPlay is searching for an experienced Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality to join our team to take ownership of safeguarding our players and protecting our platform’s integrity by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative systems to detect and prevent fraud across our loyalty gaming ecosystem.

You’ll combine strategic product ownership with a hands-on, data-driven approach to solve emerging issues while building systems and tools that improve detection precision.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own ad traffic quality and fraud prevention strategies, identifying risks across ad impressions, onboarding, engagement, and monetisation flows.

  • Develop and deploy real-time detection mechanisms, anomaly analytics, and proactive interventions to mitigate malicious behavior and abuse.

  • Collaborate with data, engineering, and product teams to build robust detection pipelines, alert systems, and responsive workflows.

  • Prioritize fraud-related KPIs such as false positives, chargeback rates, fraud velocity, and user friction metrics, driving continuous optimization.

  • Integrate A/B testing and iterative validation to refine detection models and user intervention flows.

  • Influence product design to incorporate fraud-resilient ad experiences and sustainable monetisation practices, while minimizing friction for legitimate players.

  • Stay informed on global fraud trends in mobile gaming and ad revenue-based platforms to keep our defenses innovative and effective.

Job Requirements

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in digital products with complex user behavior and ad-driven monetisation models.

  • Strong experience in AdTech or ad monetisation, such as attribution, measurement platforms, or ad networks.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using behavioral data, patterns, and signals to improve product decisions.

  • Proficient in designing and measuring the impact of A/B tests in risk and fraud scenarios.

  • Skilled at cross-functional collaboration with engineers, analysts, and operations to drive implementation of scalable fraud solutions.

  • Excellent problem-solving mindset, analytical orientation, and strong communication skills.

  • Nice to have: Experience with behavioral fraud, KYC/identity verification, Trust & Safety, risk management, or fraud prevention.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining model.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

data.title: Senior Programme Associate
data.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do
  • Support the day-to-day delivery of defence programmes and major workstreams, helping to maintain momentum across schedules, priorities, and execution.
  • Translate customer requirements, contractual inputs, and complex information into clear plans, milestones, presentations, and actionable next steps.
  • Work directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, supporting meetings, programme reviews, workshops, and delivery discussions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, business development, and external suppliers to keep programmes moving at pace.
  • Track progress, risks, actions, and dependencies, identifying issues early and helping drive them through to resolution.
  • Conduct structured analysis to support programme, commercial, and strategic decisions.
  • Support commercial and programme activities, including delivery planning, customer reporting, change control, and the preparation of proposals.
  • Prepare clear, concise programme materials that enable fast, high-quality decision-making.
  • Take ownership of defined workstreams and increasingly complex responsibilities as you develop in the role.
  • Learn by doing, operating close to real customers, real technology, real constraints, and real delivery pressure.

    • Who you are
  • An ambitious early-career professional with at least 2-3 years of experience in management consulting, DefTech, aerospace, a technology start-up, or another demanding and high-paced environment.
  • Experienced in breaking down complex or ambiguous problems, structuring your thinking, and turning analysis into practical action.
  • Comfortable operating between analysis and execution; you do not want a role confined to producing slides, reports, or recommendations.
  • Fluent or native-level in German and fluent in English, with the confidence to operate in bilingual, cross-cultural settings.
  • A strong communicator who can produce clear, concise, and well-structured written materials.
  • Highly organised, dependable, and able to manage several priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders, customers, technical teams, and external partners.
  • Curious about how complex programmes succeed commercially, technically, and organisationally.
  • Motivated by responsibility, rapid progression, and visible impact rather than narrow task ownership or rigid hierarchies.
  • Energised by working in a small, fast-moving team where expectations are high and learning is accelerated.
  • Interested in defence, advanced technology, and contributing to European sovereign capability.
  • A background in strategy, operations, engineering, technology, public policy, international relations, or a similarly relevant discipline would be valuable. A finance background is not required.

    • What we offer
  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

data.title: Chief Engineer
data.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

That is where you come in. 

As Chief Engineer, you will be one of the most important technical leaders at Hypersonica. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. 

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. 

If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. 


What you'll do
  • Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. 
  • Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. 
  • Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. 
  • Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. 
  • Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. 
  • Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. 
  • Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. 
  • Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. 
  • Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. 
  • Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. 
  • Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. 
  • Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. 
  • Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. 

    • Who you are
  • An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. 
  • Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. 
  • Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. 
  • Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. 
  • Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. 
  • Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. 
  • Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. 
  • Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. 
  • Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. 
  • Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. 
  • Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. 
  • Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. 
  • Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. 

    • You might have come from

    There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. 

    You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer. 

    You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. 

    We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. 


    What we offer
  • The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. 
  • A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. 
  • Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. 
  • Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. 
  • The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. 
  • The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. 
  • The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. 

    • The person we are looking for

    We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. 

    We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. 

    Someone who can bring clarity to complexity without slowing the organisation down. 

    If that sounds like you, come and build it with us.

data.description:
Als Technical Enterprise Architect bei Westernacher sind Sie strategischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden bei der Planung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller SAP‑S/4HANA‑Transformationen. Sie verbinden architektonische Exzellenz mit methodischem Vorgehen und unterstützen Entscheidungsprozesse auf Managementebene. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT‑Teams und Presales gestalten Sie nachhaltige, skalierbare Zielarchitekturen und sorgen für eine klare Ausrichtung von Technologie, Prozessen und Organisation.

  • Durchführung von System-Readiness-Analysen und technischen Prechecks mithilfe von SAP‑Standardtools (z. B. Readiness Check, Business Transformation Center, Maintenance Planner).

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in SAP-Projekten, einschließlich mindestens einer S/4HANA-Conversion, sowie tiefes Know-how in mindestens zwei Kernprozessen.

data.title: Product Manager - B2B SaaS (Martech) - Europe
data.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality.
 
What is our mission?
 
We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.
 
What are we offering?
 
Impact; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.
Personal Growth; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager.
Experience; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.
Delight; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.
Community; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.
 
What are we searching for?
 
Leadership, you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.
Communication, you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.
Problem Solving, you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.
Teamwork, you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them. 
Listening, despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.
Entrepreneurial Spirit, rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?
 

What You Will Do
  • Define the why, when, and what of the products our engineering team builds, leading cross-functional teams from ideation to launch.
  • Build a product and strategy that reflect Insider One’s vision, clearly articulating business value to align the team around each release.
  • Own and optimize the release process, coordinating all activities to bring products to market successfully.
  • Manage and prioritize initiatives, turning insights into actionable ideas by continuously tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies.
  • Define and analyze key product metrics to measure performance, customer satisfaction, and improvement opportunities.

    • What You Will Need
  • A Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university, preferably in Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with a B2B SaaS product.
  • Hands-on experience in Agile Product Development.
  • Exceptional decision-making and communication skills.
  • The ability to manage complex initiatives with limited supervision.
  • Fluent in English and Turkish, both written and verbal, as we have colleagues from all over the world.

    • What We Offer
  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
  • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.
    • We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. 
     
    To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
     
    If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

    We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

    Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

data.title: Sr. Compliance Associate Lead - Market Surveillance
data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Associate Lead to take on our more complex casework, own an area of the surveillance programme, and act as a senior point of reference for the analysts around them.

The opportunity

  • Take the more complex investigations end to end, including those that begin as a referral rather than an alert, and present conclusions to senior compliance stakeholders and the business.

  • Act as a senior reviewer for colleagues' work, and a point of escalation for judgement calls on how an alert or a case should be treated.

  • Contribute to threshold and model reviews, recalibrating detection as trading behaviour, products and market structure change.

  • Support surveillance platform and tooling work, including setting out what detection needs to achieve and validating that it does.

  • Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessment work, and help translate the risks identified into surveillance coverage.

 

What you bring

  • At least 4 years investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Solid knowledge of the core market abuse typologies and how they present differently across asset classes.

  • Hands-on experience with a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize, and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool.

  • Exposure to threshold or model calibration, platform integration, or market abuse risk assessment work.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication, and the judgement to know when something needs escalating.

  • Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Canada, with fluency in English.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

  • Experience mentoring or acting as a senior reviewer for less experienced analysts.

  • Experience of a surveillance platform implementation or build-out.

  • Electronic communications surveillance experience.

 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. The Role

Solution Consulting sits at the center of how Omnea wins - deals are complex, cycles are competitive, and multiple stakeholders (finance, procurement, legal, risk) all need to be convinced simultaneously. You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll partner directly with our GTM team to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder multi-country deal - and act as the voice of the market back into product and GTM: what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

  • Scope, design, and own proof-of-concept projects end to end, combining a prospect's current state and processes within the Omnea platform to validate what that specific buying committee needs to see - not only a demo can run smoothly.

  • Mentor teammates on customer engagement and technical strategy, and help define what a great Solution Consultant at Omnea actually looks like, since the function itself is still being built.

  • Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.


What's Different About This Role

  • This is a career-defining chance to help build Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function from the ground up in the U.S., at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

  • You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

  • Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works from the ground up. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

  • 5-7+ years in enterprise sales engineering, solutions engineering, or senior technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Proven as a top-performing individual contributor, with the ambition to go further: helping shape how the Solution Consulting function operates, not just working inside it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. data.title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
data.description:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel focused on privacy, to join our dynamic and growing Privacy team. You will play a leading role in the strategic development and operational implementation of our privacy program, with the opportunity of exploring more general legal and regulatory affairs focused matters, as necessary.

  • Conduct comprehensive data protection due diligence on prospective and existing business partners

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex data protection agreements, clauses, and terms.

  • Provide expert legal advice and guidance on a broad spectrum of data protection issues to various business units, senior management, and project teams.

  • Mentor junior team members and contribute significantly to the professional development and knowledge sharing within the Privacy team, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

  • Handle any data breaches and associated reporting requirements in a timely and compliant manner;

THE OPPORTUNITY
  • Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers.
  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.
  • Qualify inbound leads against set criteria, using strong questioning to identify true fit and move the right opportunities forward.
  • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.
  • Build a solid understanding of our technology and solutions, and clearly explain the problems we solve and the value we deliver to prospects.

  • Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams.
  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.
  • Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures.
  • Contribute to and lead team meetings on a monthly basis on topics relevant to the role. 
  • Pipeline review with weekly team meeting 
  • Other duties as assigned. 

    •  

     


    THE SKILL SET
  • Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives.
  • Fluent English and German speaker.
  • Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision.
  • Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach).

  • Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and strong planning skills.
  • Demonstrated coachability - you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously refine your approach.

  • Strong self-learning mindset: proactive in developing your sales craft through reading, testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong ownership mentality - takes responsibility for pipeline creation, follow-through, and results without outsourcing challenges.
  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift efforts based on business goals and team needs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Claude, including running account and contact research, creating and maintaining projects with reusable context, using and building Claude skills for repeatable workflows (research, call prep, sequence drafting), and checking outputs before they reach a prospect.
  • Ambitious about long-term career growth in sales, with a clear desire to progress into quota-carrying roles.
  • Must be able to travel as needed (For marketing / sales events and internal meetups in Europe and Sales Kick-Off in the U.S) 

    • THE BENEFITS
  • Fully remote based with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the UK
  • Flexible working hours
  • Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
  • 25 vacation days per year in addition to public holidays
  • 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).

As a contract Child and Adolescent nurse practitioner, you will provide essential clinical care. This role emphasizes core competencies such as diagnostic expertise, family engagement, ethical practice, and continuous improvement to ensure the highest standard of care.

You’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 30-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

 

You will provide care to children, teens, and young adults from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

  • Conduct mental health risk assessments, psychiatric medication evaluations, and longitudinal medication treatment
  • Construct patient-centered treatment plans, document treatment recommendations, message patients, and prescribe and manage psychiatric medications

data.title: Director of International Product
data.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

Lyra is looking for a visionary and strategic Director, International Product to lead and scale our global mental health offerings. As Lyra grows around the world, you’ll shape how we deliver high-quality, culturally relevant care to members, providers, and employers in every market we serve.

You’ll serve as the connective tissue between our global commercial ambitions and technical execution, guiding multiple simultaneous initiatives and building a platform-first, repeatable engine for international growth. Working alongside senior leadership, you’ll own the strategic vision, delivery, and performance of the international product suite.

The leaders who thrive in this role pair high standards with real care for the people around them. They build strong relationships across the organization, earn influence through trust and clarity, and bring steady, energizing leadership to their teams, especially when the path ahead is uncertain


What You'll Do:
  • Global Product Vision & Strategy: Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for Lyra’s international product suite, grounded in market analysis, competitive insight, and firsthand understanding of the members, providers, and clients we serve in each region. Synthesize global market signals into a clear point of view on where to invest for the greatest impact for global employers.
  • Product Scope & Ownership: Hold full lifecycle responsibility for the scoping, development, and delivery of member experiences and the underlying platform infrastructure across four major product lines: International Lyra Workforce Mental Health (WFMH), Global Lyra Wellbeing, 10 Local Lyra Wellbeing products, and other product surface areas as needed.
  • Platform-First Scale: Lead the evolution of our international offerings onto a unified global platform, with automated workflows that make each new client launch faster and more repeatable than the last. Champion the localization of core capabilities, including billing, eligibility, and provider management, so they flex gracefully across markets.
  • Roadmap Stewardship: Balance the needs of today’s clients with durable, long-term platform investments. Make clear, well-reasoned tradeoffs, explain the “why” behind them in a way that brings people along, and have the conviction to say “not yet” when that’s what best serves members and the business.
  • Leadership & Team Development: Build and lead the International Product team. Hire and grow exceptional people, including leaders whose strengths go beyond your own, and invest in their development through candid, caring feedback and meaningful ownership. Your success is measured by how well your team thrives: clearing the path, providing context, and creating the conditions for others to do their best work.
  • Business Ownership & Resourcing: Create and manage the annual budget for International Product. Assess resourcing needs and build compelling business cases to secure the investment needed to reach ambitious growth targets.
  • Cost-to-Serve & Performance Insight: Partner with the Data organization to build a single, trusted view of international performance, giving leadership clear visibility into margins, ROI, and utilization. Define and track the product metrics that measure success, and identify opportunities to streamline and automate so global products are built for long-term profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the central connector across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Clinical Governance, Legal, and Compliance. Build trusted relationships across regions and time zones, including in our local operations work toward win-win outcomes amid competing priorities, and ensure clinical quality and local regulatory requirements are built into the product lifecycle from the start.
  • Go-To-Market Partnership: Act as a trusted partner to Go-To-Market and Client Services teams. Serve as the product voice in high-stakes, C-level client conversations and complex RFPs, bringing the technical and clinical confidence that helps Lyra win and retain large-scale global contracts.
  • AI-Enabled Product Excellence: Maintain a high bar for product craft and apply AI with purpose, both in our products, where it can meaningfully expand access and improve care, and in how we work. Model how AI can accelerate research, synthesis, planning, and execution, and help your team adopt tools and practices that drive efficiency, effectiveness, and happiness.

    • What You'll Bring:
  • Experience: Several years in product management, strategy, or technical operations.
  • Leadership: Several years of people leadership, with a track record of building strong teams and coaching talent to grow beyond their current roles.
  • Global Product Expertise: Experience launching and scaling products across multiple countries, including localizing for language, culture, and care norms, and navigating regional privacy and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, data residency). A natural instinct to design for local context, informed by real cultural fluency.
  • Platform & Enterprise Architecture: Deep understanding of bringing multiple systems together onto a unified global platform and reducing the effort required for each new client launch.
  • Commercial & Financial Acumen: Advanced skills in multivariable planning, budget ownership, and resource forecasting in a complex, matrixed environment. You think like a business owner and use data on product health, margin, ROI, and utilization to guide strategy.
  • Executive Influence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can distill complexity into a crisp narrative, write a document that drives a decision, and adapt your message for engineers, clinicians, and C-level executives alike. A demonstrated track record of influencing senior leaders and key external stakeholders through credibility and trust, along with strong negotiation skills.
  • High Performance under Complexity: Ability to analyze changing, multivariable situations and set objectives with high impact on company goals. You make sound calls with incomplete information, move comfortably between the details and the big picture, keep momentum when plans shift, and stay composed and solutions-oriented when headwinds arise.
  • Practical AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI to meaningfully accelerate your own work and your team’s, with the discernment to know where it adds real value.
  • Culture & Psychological Safety: A model of Lyra’s values who fosters psychological safety across the team, welcomes nuanced feedback, and makes it safe for team members to voice differing opinions. You hold strong opinions loosely, change your mind when the evidence warrants, and share credit freely.
  • Mission & People Focus: A passion for Lyra’s mission. Your curiosity and empathy come naturally: they show up in the questions you ask, the time you spend with members, providers, and clients, and the products you build as a result.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) required; MBA or equivalent professional experience preferred.

data.description:
At Aevi, we're not just a team; we're a vibrant, global business, committed to shaking up the payments industry. Our culture is all about innovation, creativity, and a passion for pushing boundaries. About the role

As a Content & SEO Manager, you’ll own Aevi’s content and SEO from start to finish: what we publish, why we publish it and whether it works.

You’ll turn the knowledge of our Product, Engineering, Sales and Partnerships teams into clear, well-researched content that ranks, gets read and helps our Sales and Partner teams win. Your work will make Aevi easier to find and understand for merchants, acquirers and partners.

Until now, much of our content and SEO has been handled by an external agency. You’ll bring this work in-house, drawing directly on our own experts and helping us set priorities week by week. Reporting to the Director of Marketing & Communications, you’ll work closely with Marketing Operations, our Digital Communications Manager, our Senior Designer and experts across Product, Engineering, Sales and Partnerships.

  • This is a remote-first role based in London or Prague. You’ll work mainly from home and join the team in the office for planning days, workshops and expert interviews.

    Being part of Aevi? Flexibility, honesty, development, and support are the essentials of our work environment, and we live for a “work smarter, not harder” mindset. data.description:
The role

We are looking to hire a Enterprise Account Executive - API Solutions to join our EMEA sales team in London. 

This is an on-site role out of our London office

 

Working at WGSN

Together, we create tomorrow 

A career with WGSN is fast-paced, exciting and full of opportunities to grow and develop. We're a team of consumer and design trend forecasters, content creators, designers, data analysts, advisory consultants and much more, united by a common goal: to create tomorrow. 

WGSN's trusted consumer and design forecasts power outstanding product design, enabling our customers to create a better future. Our services cover consumer insights, beauty, consumer tech, fashion, interiors, lifestyle, food and drink forecasting, data analytics and expert advisory. If you are an expert in your field, we want to hear from you. 

About the Role

We are seeking a high performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new logo acquisition for the WGSN Intelligence API.

For 28 years, WGSN has provided category-leading trend intelligence to the world’s top consumer brands. As enterprise clients rebuild their systems around AI, this role is responsible for selling high-value, direct API integrations that embed WGSN’s proprietary intelligence into client design tools, merchandising platforms, e-commerce environments, and AI agents.

This is a pure hunting role focused on closing complex, enterprise integration deals across fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods, and fintech.

Key accountabilities

  • Pipeline Generation: Proactively source and build a net-new enterprise pipeline targeting C suite and VP level buyers (Chief Digital, Data, Innovation, and Product Officers).

  • Technical & Consultative Selling: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for complex, high-value API integrations. Conduct deep consultative discovery to map WGSN API capabilities directly to client technical architectures and business cases.

  • Deal Ownership & Orchestration: Direct the complete sales process from origination to signature. Strategically pull in internal technical specialists only when needed for deep scoping.

  • IP Protection & Commercial Discipline: Structure deals within established pricing and legal guardrails, ensuring strict protection of WGSN’s intellectual property, training-data exclusions, and brand attribution.

  • Pipeline & Forecast Management: Maintain accurate forecasting, deal stage hygiene, and pipeline coverage metrics.

Skills, experience & qualifications

  • Background in trend intelligence, syndicated consumer data, SaaS, or enterprise AI/ML platforms is preferred.

  • Consistent history of exceeding quotas in an individual contributor, net-new enterprise hunting role closing $1M+ multi-year deals.

  • Ability to independently lead technical discussions with senior data and technology buyers. Solid working knowledge of enterprise integration models, including REST/streaming APIs, authentication, and enterprise AI/ML architectures (e.g., RAG, embedded copilots, AI agents).

  • Expert at navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments across technical, product, and commercial business units.

  • Strong qualification discipline; ability to identify non-viable deals early and protect IP standards without compromising revenue goals.

  • Existing network of senior digital, data, and innovation leaders within Tier-1 retail and consumer brands preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI content licensing models, including training-data protections and brand attribution terms is preferred. 

What we offer

Our benefits and wellbeing package offers flexible benefits you can tailor to your own personal needs, including:  

- 25 days of holiday per year - with an option to buy/ sell up to 5 days
- Pension, Life Assurance and Income Protection Flexible benefits platform with options including Private Medical, Dental Insurance & Critical Illness 
- Employee assistance programme, season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme 
- Volunteering opportunities and charitable giving options  
- Great learning and development opportunities.


More about WGSN

WGSN is the global authority on consumer trend forecasting.

We help brands around the world create the right products at the right time for tomorrow’s consumer.


Our values 

We Are Everywhere
The future is everything, it happens everywhere. WGSN is the world-leading forecaster because we track and analyse consumer behaviours, product innovation, design and creativity, everywhere.

We Are Future Focused
We utilise our global resources and intelligence to research, source and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to produce our forecasts. Everything we do is focused on working with our customers to create a successful and positive tomorrow.

We Are Rigorous
We source, review and assess quantitative and qualitative data to produce robust, actionable forecasts. To provide credible insights and design solutions for our clients, it is essential that rigour runs through everything we do.


Our culture 

An inclusive culture is one of our key priorities. We want our people to truly be themselves and thrive. We love having a diverse team of people who bring new ideas, different strengths and perspectives & reflect the global audience we work with.


Inclusive workforce 

We are committed to supporting the environment and sustainability, including ensuring our pension plan defaults to sustainable options and striving to be net zero by 2030.  

Recognising great performance is a key part of our culture. Our Awards schemes recognise and reward the brilliant achievements of our people.  

We offer a flexible working environment with a wide range of flexible, hybrid and agile working arrangements. Conversations about flexible working have always been—and will continue to be—actively encouraged here, but we do not offer full remote working. 

We want to ensure everyone has the opportunity to perform their best when interviewing, so if you require any reasonable adjustments that would make you more comfortable during the process, please let us know so that we can do our best to support you.


A Note for Applicants

We use AI to help our team screen applications and identify candidates whose skills and experience match the role. This technology removes personal information to promote a fair and unbiased process. We believe this tool helps us find the best talent while maintaining transparency and fairness.


A Note for Recruiters 

Thank you so much for your interest in working with us at  WGSN!   Our internal Talent Acquisition team takes care of all our recruitment efforts. When we need some extra help, we partner with agencies on our Preferred Supplier List (PSL) that truly understand our business, culture and ways of working together.  Since we focus on these established partnerships, we’re unable to respond to unsolicited contacts or CVs from outside our PSL. But don’t worry! If we decide to explore new partnerships, we’ll be sure to reach out.

Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
 
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
 
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
 
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
 
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
 
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?
 

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.


    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

     

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that.

We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment.

You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale.

What You’ll Do

You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests.

  • Hold the senior relationships—be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations.

  • Find the value nobody has scoped—go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next.

  • Define best practice for AI deployment—set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale.

  • Shape our roadmap—bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build.

You Might Be a Great Fit if You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role

  • Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted

  • Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue

  • Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information

Compensation and Benefits
